title: Upgrades, People, Upgrades
description:
Now, you're probably looking at your tool and thinkin' it's nice and all, but everything can be improved, can't it? Well, lemme tell you about upgrades. There ain't a lotta them, but is still good t' know.
Upgrade Bases are simple, made with stone, wood, and 2 sticks. There's only one basic upgrade, and that's the Red Card, an upgrade that makes it so yer tools break like regular ones instead of going into a broken state. Why you'd want this, I'm not sure, but there's probably a use for it somewhere.
[Advanced Upgrades are next, the base crafted with your basic bases, some gold, and some diamond shards](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/advanced_upgrade_base.png:124:62). Real simple stuff. Advanced upgrades include extending the radius of hammers and excavators, making yer tools magnetic, makin' pathways with excavators, an' a spoon... for sum reason.
